## NChat v1.1.1

A coding-focused update for the portable Windows app.

### Coding workflow
- Coding mode is enabled by default and adds project-aware instructions to requests.
- The empty chat offers quick starts to explore a project, find a bug, plan a change or prepare a commit.

### Chat interface
- Provider errors now appear as readable cards with suggested next steps, retry and provider switching; raw diagnostics are available on demand.
- Provider, model, reasoning, coding mode and project folder controls now live inside the composer. Send and Stop actions are labeled clearly.
- The message history, chat list and title bar have been refined for easier scanning.

Portable Windows 10/11 x64 build. Requires Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime. Replace the old `NChat.exe` with the file below.

## NChat v1.1.0

Moved to **Tauri 2 + React**. Portable `NChat.exe` for Windows 10/11 x64, runs on the system WebView2. Size is ~33 MB instead of ~93 MB. Data from `%APPDATA%\nchat` is picked up automatically.

### What's new
- **Tools**: 144 tools in 27 groups — files, terminal, git, network, screen and OCR, documents, recycle bin, UI Automation and more. All are always available; dangerous actions ask for confirmation.
- **MCP**: servers from `mcp.json` (stdio and HTTP), tools appear as `mcp__<server>__<tool>`.
- **Skills and packs**: `@pack` enables several skills at once, `/skill` enables one. Rename, describe and delete them in settings.
- **Interface**: per-language code highlighting, save a code block via “Save as…”, `/` and `@` calls are highlighted in the accent color, “Memory” is a card above the input field.
- **Updates**: checks GitHub Releases, downloads with progress, verifies SHA-256 and replaces itself.

### What was removed
- Electron, Node and the NSIS installer — the app is portable.
- Local whisper — you can delete the `%APPDATA%\nchat\whisper` folder manually.
- Sound notifications and the `sound_get` command.
- Tool group toggles — the “Tools” tab is now only for MCP.

### Updating
Download `NChat.exe` below and replace the old file.

SHA-256: `7085CEE59872AA88919CC84E930FEE03E16DE2C4BAFB9CE03D21A89968B74309`
v1.0.9:
## NChat v1.0.9

### Light theme without “white on white”
- The default accent is now `#e2e3e3` instead of pure white: easier on the eyes in both themes.
- The “New chat” button no longer blends into the background — in the light theme it is graphite with white text.
- The active tab in settings is readable: text and underline are darkened to graphite instead of white.
- The context circle by the input field: the percentage on hover is no longer white on white.

### Contrast across the interface
- Skill names and icons, provider cards, links in replies, attachment icons, MCP badges and panel toggles in the title bar all use a readable version of the accent color: in the dark theme it matches the accent, in the light theme it is darkened automatically.

### Technical
- A new CSS variable `--accent-text` is computed from the accent via HSL: the hue is kept and the lightness is adjusted to stay readable on the theme background.
v1.0.8:
## NChat v1.0.8

### Painless updates
- **New version toast** in the bottom right: checked at startup, “Install” downloads and applies on restart, “Remind me in 30 min”, the cross hides it until restart.

### Tray
- The close button minimizes to the tray instead of quitting — getting back to work is instant.
- App-styled tray menu (like Telegram): right-click the icon for a dark “Open NChat / Quit” card, left-click opens the window right away.

### Model replies
- Strict structure: short paragraphs, lists, numbered steps, build statuses line by line, no walls of text.

### Settings
- Removed the “Updates” and “About me” blocks — updates now come only through the toast, saved data keeps working.

### Speed
- Streaming no longer re-renders the whole chat: bubbles, sidebar and context counter are lighter; the settings dialog loads lazily; the tray popup no longer stays in memory.
v1.0.7:
## NChat v1.0.7

Added 12 new tools for the AI.

### Code and tests
- **tail_file** — last lines of a file without reading all of it, handy for logs
- **code_stats** — codebase statistics: files, lines, breakdown by language
- **outdated_packages** — outdated dependencies (npm outdated / pip list --outdated)
- **dependency_audit** — checks dependencies for vulnerabilities (npm audit / pip-audit)

### Text and data
- **format_code** — formats JSON and XML with indentation
- **color_convert** — converts colors between hex, rgb and hsl
- **curl_import** — parses a curl command into HTTP request parameters

### Documents
- **csv_json** — converts between CSV and JSON both ways

### Database
- **sql_schema** — SQLite database schema: tables, columns, types and indexes

### Archives and disk
- **find_duplicates** — finds duplicate files by content (hash)

### Video and audio
- **ffmpeg_convert** — converts a media file to another format
- **extract_audio** — extracts the audio track from a video
- **trim_media** — cuts a fragment without re-encoding

The “Video and audio” group is now enabled by default.

### Security
- Tools that write files or start processes require confirmation; writing outside the project folder is always confirmed.
- External utilities (ffmpeg, sqlite3, pip-audit), when missing, give a clear message with the install command.
- No new dependencies were added.

v1.0.5:
Portable NChat build for Windows x64. No installation needed.

A release about memory and convenience: the context summary moved to its own panel, a real “remember” arrived, along with auto chat titles, conversation branches and update checks.

## “Memory” panel

- The context summary moved out of the chat feed into its own tab on the right: narrative, facts, decisions, requirements, entities, tasks and Git. When collapsed, a narrow label remains.
- Summarize with Ctrl+M (configurable). The process is always visible: a spinner in the panel and a toast under the title bar — what is running, what is done, why it did not start. Success and errors fade on their own after 5 seconds.
- Fixed parsing of the model's reply: raw JSON no longer spills into the interface, and broken replies from small free models turn into a clear error without losing the old memory.

## “Remember” and “About me”

- Write “remember that…” in the chat and the fact is pinned right away and sent with every model request as a separate block. The summary will never overwrite it.
- Pinned facts are visible and editable in the “Memory” panel and survive chat export and import.
- Settings → “About me”: facts remembered across all chats at once (name, preferences, time zone). They go into the system prompt of every request.
- Personal data is priority #1 for the auto-summary too: kept word for word and never removed by updates.

## Chat titles and tab menu

- After the first messages the model comes up with a short chat title on its own. Manually renamed chats are left alone; this can be turned off in settings.
- Right-click a chat in the list: regenerate the title, rename, pin, export to Markdown/JSON, delete.
- If the model stays silent, the title is taken from the first words instead of staying “New chat”. Old chats with auto titles are picked up automatically.

## Conversation branches

- “Regenerate” and “Edit” no longer overwrite anything: the old version is kept as an alternative branch.
- The “‹ 1/3 ›” switcher under a message flips through versions, and the current one is kept too. Branches live in the chat file, survive restarts and go into export and import.

## Updates

- Settings → “Updates”: app version, a check button and a JSON feed URL field in the form `{"version": "1.1.0", "url": "…", "notes": "…"}`.
- At startup the app quietly checks the feed and shows a system notification if a new version is out.
v1.0.4:
Portable NChat build for Windows x64. No installation needed.

A big expansion of the toolset: 44 new tools split into groups. Each group can be turned on or off in settings — schemas of disabled groups don't use up context.

## Images (enabled)

- `image_info` — image dimensions and file size.
- `image_resize` — resize and compress. The `max_bytes` parameter picks the quality so the file fits the limit: this fixes providers refusing images larger than 5 MB.
- `image_convert` — png ⇄ jpeg.
- `image_crop` — crop to a rectangle.

## Code and tests (enabled)

- `read_files` — several files in one call, cheaper on context.
- `run_tests` — detects the runner itself: vitest, jest, pytest or a test script.
- `run_linter` — eslint, prettier, ruff or black, with or without fixes.
- `project_check` — type checking and build without going through the shell.
- `apply_patch` — applies a unified diff, cheaper than rewriting the whole file.
- `replace_in_files` — bulk regex replace with a preview before writing.
- `find_symbol` — where a symbol is declared and where it is used.

## Background tasks (enabled)

- `background_start` — runs a long command in the background: dev servers, builds and package installs no longer hit the timeout.
- `background_list`, `background_output`, `background_stop` — status, output, stop.
- `watch_path` — watches a file or folder for changes.

## Text and data (enabled)

- `text_diff` — line-by-line comparison of texts or files.
- `encode_text`, `hash_text` — base64, URL, hex and hashes of a string.
- `regex_test` — tests a regular expression on examples.
- `json_query`, `json_convert` — query by path and convert JSON ⇄ YAML ⇄ TOML.
- `generate_data`, `jwt_decode`.

## Disabled by default

- Advanced Git: stash, reset, revert, cherry-pick, tags, clone, remote, blame, merge, rebase. `git_reset` and `git_rebase` always ask for confirmation.
- Web search: `web_search` without an API key and `extract_selector` by CSS selector.
- Network diagnostics: `dns_lookup`, `whois_lookup`, `traceroute`, `ssl_check`.
- Documents: text from PDF, reading docx and xlsx, CSV with filters, Markdown to HTML.
- SQLite: `sqlite_query`. Requires sqlite3 on the system, otherwise suggests how to install it.
- Windows system: programs, startup, event log, WMI, windows, battery, Wi-Fi.
- Project tasks: `task_add`, `task_list`, `task_update`, `task_remove`. Stored as a file in the project folder.
- Video and audio: `media_info` via ffprobe. If ffmpeg isn't installed, the tool says so honestly and suggests how to install it.

## Fixed

- Console output encoding: Russian text from netsh, tracert and PowerShell no longer turns into garbage.
v1.0.3:
Portable NChat build for Windows x64. No installation needed.

## Questions from the model

- New `ask_user` tool: if a task is ambiguous, the model asks a question in a separate window and waits for the answer instead of guessing.
- The model decides how many questions to ask and which options to offer. Several questions are shown one at a time with a “1 of 3” counter and a “Next” button.
- Single or multiple choice answers, or your own text answer. Enter — next, Shift+Enter — new line, Esc — skip.
- Declining to answer doesn't break anything: the tool returns “the user declined to answer”. There is no time limit on waiting for an answer.
- The tool is always available and can't be disabled in settings.

## Time in chat

- Each message shows its time next to the role label, with the full date on hover.
- Tool calls show completion time and duration: `delete_path · done · 20:00:00 · 1.2 s`. Old chats don't show time.

## Attachments

- Clicking an image in the chat opens it full screen: Esc, a click on the background or the button closes it.
v1.0.2:
Portable NChat build for Windows x64. No installation needed.

## Performance

- Reply output no longer stutters: text is pushed to the interface ~20 times per second instead of every frame, in larger chunks. Markdown parsing and redraws happen three times less often, and the stream stays smooth.

## Chats

- Export a chat to Markdown and JSON, import from JSON. The file is saved to the Downloads folder.
- The input draft is remembered per chat — an unfinished message is no longer lost when switching between conversations.

## Keys

- Command palette on Ctrl+K: new chat, export, import, theme, pin, compress context, stop reply, jump to any chat by name.
- All shortcuts are configurable: Settings → Keys. Includes reset to defaults, a warning for taken shortcuts and support for the Russian keyboard layout.
- Defaults: Ctrl+K palette, Ctrl+N new chat, Ctrl+B chat list, Ctrl+F search in chat, Ctrl+E export, Ctrl+Tab and Ctrl+Shift+Tab to switch chats.

## Interface

- Reasoning collapses right after the reply arrives. Can be turned off in settings.
- The settings window is responsive: the tab row wraps in a narrow window, padding and font size shrink at small widths, and “label — control” rows stack.
v1.0.1:
Portable NChat build for Windows x64. No installation needed.

## Interface

- The window opens at the size and position where you closed it (and maximized if it was), not always 1240×820 in the center.
- The “Allow action?” dialog for `edit_file` shows a line-by-line diff: removed lines in red, added lines in green. For `write_file` — the beginning of the content, for commands — the command itself. The file path is on its own line, and the full JSON of arguments is tucked under “All arguments”.
- The context fill ring shows real tokens from the provider instead of the “characters ÷ 4 + 14000” estimate. The numbers will differ (usually lower); after context compression the counter resets and is refined with the next reply.
- The font loads from the app folder — it looks the same even offline.

## Performance

- Less input lag during streaming: only the changed chat is written to disk, not the whole history. `data.json` shrinks from megabytes to kilobytes — chats moved to `%APPDATA%\nchat\chats\`, attachments go to `attachments\`. Migration is automatic and your history stays intact.
- Faster project search: `grep_search` reads files in batches of 8 and skips large ones before reading. Several `read_file` / `grep_search` calls in one turn run in parallel.

## Tools

- `search_files` with a pattern like `src/**/*.ts` now finds nested files — before it only found the top level. If the walk hits the 4000-file limit, the reply now says so instead of a silent “nothing found”.
